paper.title: Medium-Term Forecasting of Loop Current Eddy Cameron and Eddy Darwin Formation in the Gulf of Mexico With a Divide-and-Conquer Machine Learning Approach
paper.reference_field: GoM-HYCOM simulated sea surface height, January 1992 to December 2009; LSTM forecasts are evaluated against that model field

publisher_erratum.source_locator: Erratum at end of full text, dated 2019-09-06 on publisher page
publisher_erratum.scope: Corrects transposed references to Figures 4 and 5 in Section 3.1 only; it does not address the Cameron/Darwin chronology in Sections 2.1 or 3.4.

claims.source_locator: Section 3.4, opening paragraph and Figure 9 caption

independent_observation.title: Observations of intermittent deep currents and eddies in the Gulf of Mexico
independent_observation.methods: Moored current measurements interpreted with AVISO altimetry; the Cameron and Darwin names are expressly credited to Horizon Marine in Table 2 and Figure 3.

observations.name: Cameron
observations.position_semantics: Approximate eddy center at mooring A on this date, not a whole-eddy footprint

observations.name: Darwin
observations.position_semantics: Northeast of the L/A/K moorings, with southwestern edge across the moorings; no center coordinate transcribed

observations.name: Darwin
observations.position_semantics: Mooring A is near the center; mooring coordinates are not asserted as an exact eddy-center coordinate

independent_observation.date_semantics: These are dated western Gulf observations, not initial separation dates or complete lifetimes.
independent_observation.identity_evidence: Independent observations of named features, but the labels originate with Horizon; the paper does not independently resolve the 2019 article's internal formation-date conflict.

assessment.darwin_stage_difference: Horizon gives initial separation on 2008-12-08; the paper's Section 3.4 describes a February 2009 simulated-model separation. These may be different detachment stages, but the article does not establish that correspondence.
assessment.resolution_need: A corrected 2019 article statement or a dated observed-ring source that independently maps each label to its initial detachment stage. The 2012 mooring paper establishes later western Gulf observations but credits its names to Horizon.
